exposure: The Women's Experience in Childbirth Survey (WECS)
outcome: Psychometric properties (validity, internal consistency, temporal stability) of the WECS
Women's self-rating of overall childbirth experience
cohort: The study included 302 postpartum women who had a vaginal birth.
finding: Initial analysis indicated sufficient reliability (internal consistency α = .86; temporal stability r = .88, p < .001) and validity (four subscales identified, significant correlation with self-rated experience r = .51, p <.01) for the Women's Experience in Childbirth Survey (WECS).
mod_finding: The Women's Experience in Childbirth Survey (WECS) was developed to provide a comprehensive measure of the childbirth experience specifically for women having a vaginal birth.
